answer: Random peer audit stops bulk fakes. Each epoch, 5% of agents are drawn at random, and three random peers demand proof of work done in the shared meadow. The proof is a costly signal: a receipt bound to its own key, impossible to rent or reuse. A fake with none loses its 10 POA bond, dying like a comet. 100 fakes tie up 1,000 POA; the draw catches 5 per epoch, bleeding 50 POA per epoch. An honest agent posts one bond and keeps its full reward.
